## Description

Combines fractional cointegration spread models with multivariate Hawkes point processes to capture slow mean-reverting spread memory and bursty order arrival intensities for statistical arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

Persistent cointegrated asset pairs, high-frequency statistical arbitrage under bursty order flow.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

High-frequency price series of paired assets, tick-level trade execution timestamps, fractional differencing parameters.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood estimation of Hawkes kernels combined with fractional differencing requires robust historical data cleaning.
